info.title: Rantau API
info.description: API for sub-districts, places, place reviews, place suggestions, place categories, and authentication. Successful JSON responses are wrapped in data; errors contain code and message.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Register users, authenticate, and manage refresh-token sessions.

tags.name: Places
tags.description: List, get, create, update, and delete places.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: List and write star ratings and comments for places. Each user reviews a place at most once.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: List and get place categories with their custom fields. Categories and their fields are defined in the database migrations.

tags.name: Sub-districts
tags.description: List, read, create, update, and delete sub-districts.

tags.name: Suggestions
tags.description: Suggest places for review, list suggestions, and approve or reject them. Users see their own suggestions; admins review all of them.

post.description: Creates a user and returns their ID, name, and email. No tokens or cookies are issued; log in separately to authenticate.

409.description: A user with this email already exists.

post.description: Authenticates a user and issues an access token. The refresh token is set in an HttpOnly cookie and is not included in the response body.

200.description: Login successful. The refresh token cookie is set.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly refresh_token cookie scoped to /v1/auth; SameSite=Strict and Secure according to server configuration.

401.description: The email or password is incorrect.

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. The refresh token is read from and replaced in the HttpOnly cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Replacement HttpOnly refresh_token cookie scoped to /v1/auth; SameSite=Strict and Secure according to server configuration.

401.description: The refresh token cookie is missing, or the refresh token is invalid or expired. The cookie is cleared when the token is invalid or expired.

post.description: Revokes the refresh-token session if a refresh_token cookie is present, then clears the cookie. Calling without the cookie is also successful.

204.description: Logged out successfully. No response body.

get.description: Returns places, optionally filtered. Filters are combined with AND.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across place name, address, short description, and category name.

parameters.name: sub_district_id
parameters.description: Only return places in this sub-district.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Comma-separated category IDs. Returns places in any of the given categories.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Only return places located inside this box, edges included, as west,south,east,north in degrees. West must not exceed east, nor south north. Places without a location are left out. The places are spread over the box: it is split into a grid of about limit square cells (sized by a power of two and fixed to longitude and latitude 0, so it does not move as the box pans), each cell takes its categories in turns, and the first place of every cell comes before any second one. Within a round, the places nearest the centre of the box come first; remaining ties are ordered by ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many places: the first of the spread over bbox (which this limit sizes the grid of), or those with the lowest IDs when there is no bbox. total still counts every match.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many places, in the same order limit uses, before limit applies. Use it with limit to page through the places. total still counts every match.

200.description: Places retrieved successfully, with the number of matches before the offset and limit. An empty result returns an empty places array and a total of 0.

total.description: Places matching the filters, including those skipped by offset or cut off by limit.

400.description: sub_district_id or category_id is not a valid positive integer, limit is not a positive integer, offset is not a non-negative integer, or bbox is not four valid coordinates (INVALID_SUB_DISTRICT_ID, INVALID_CATEGORY_ID, INVALID_LIMIT, INVALID_OFFSET, INVALID_BBOX).

404.description: The sub-district or category filter refers to an ID that does not exist.

post.description: Creates a place. Requires the admin role. The attributes object must match the fields of the chosen category: required fields must be present, and unknown keys are rejected.

get.description: Returns a place with its category.

400.description: The place ID is invalid.

put.description: Replaces a place's editable fields. Requires the admin role. Send every field: nullable fields left out or sent as null are cleared. The attributes are validated against the category's fields. The place's rating and medias are kept.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or a value failed validation.

delete.description: Deletes a place. Requires the admin role.

204.description: Place deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The place ID is invalid.

post.description: Returns a presigned URL for uploading a new image of the place straight to storage. Requires the admin role. Send the image as the body of a request with the returned method and headers before expires_at (5 minutes), then confirm it with POST /v1/places/{id}/medias. Unconfirmed uploads are deleted after a day.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or the content type is not JPEG, PNG, or WebP.

value.message: image must be JPEG, PNG, or WebP

post.description: Confirms an uploaded image and adds it to the place's medias at the lowest free position (1 to 10). Requires the admin role. A place has at most 10 medias. The upload must have been requested for this place's medias, and the image must be a JPEG, PNG, or WebP of at most 5 MB whose type matches the one it was requested for.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, the upload key is not one requested for this place's medias, nothing was uploaded under it, or the image is too large or of the wrong type.

delete.description: Removes the media from the place and deletes its image. The other medias keep their positions. Requires the admin role.

204.description: Media deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The place ID or the media ID is invalid.

404.description: The place has no such media.

get.description: Returns the place's reviews with their authors, newest first.

400.description: The place ID is invalid.

post.description: Stores the signed-in user's star rating and optional comment for the place, and adds the rating to the place's rating_average and rating_count. Any signed-in user may review, and each user reviews a place at most once. The comment is trimmed, a blank comment is stored as null, and it may be at most 1000 characters. Add medias afterwards with POST /v1/places/{id}/reviews/mine/medias.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or a value failed validation.

409.description: The user has already reviewed this place.

example.message: place already reviewed by this user

post.description: Returns a presigned URL for uploading a new media of the signed-in user's review of the place straight to storage. Send the file as the body of a request with the returned method and headers before expires_at (5 minutes), then confirm it with POST /v1/places/{id}/reviews/mine/medias.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or the content type is not allowed.

value.message: file must be a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, or an MP4 or WebM video

404.description: The signed-in user has not reviewed the place.

post.description: Confirms an uploaded file and adds it to the signed-in user's review of the place at the lowest free position (1 to 10). A review has at most 10 medias. The upload must have been requested for this user's review of this place, and the file must be within its size limit and of the type it was requested for.

400.description: The place ID is invalid, the body is malformed, the upload key is not one requested for this user's review of this place, nothing was uploaded under it, or the file is too large or of the wrong type.

404.description: The signed-in user has not reviewed the place.

delete.description: Removes the media from the signed-in user's review of the place and deletes its file. Later medias move up one position.

204.description: Media deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The place ID or the media ID is invalid.

404.description: The signed-in user's review of the place has no such media.

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in user's review of the place and its medias, and takes its rating off the place's rating_average and rating_count. The user may then review the place again.

204.description: Review deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The place ID is invalid.

404.description: The signed-in user has not reviewed the place.

delete.description: Deletes the review and its medias, and takes its rating off the place's rating_average and rating_count. The author may then review the place again. Requires the admin role.

204.description: Review deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The place ID or the review ID is invalid.

404.description: The place has no such review.

get.description: Returns all categories with their custom fields.
Returns a category with its custom fields.

400.description: The category ID is invalid.

get.description: Returns suggestions, oldest first, optionally filtered by status. Requires the admin role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return suggestions in this status. Omit to return all of them.

200.description: Suggestions retrieved successfully. An empty result returns an empty data array.

400.description: The status is not pending, approved, or rejected.

example.message: status must be pending, approved, or rejected

post.description: Stores the signed-in user's suggestion of a place as pending review. Any signed-in user may suggest a place, and the author is the user in the access token. Each user may have at most 5 pending suggestions at a time.

201.description: Suggestion created successfully and pending review.

400.description: The request body is malformed, a value failed validation, or the sub-district or category does not exist.

429.description: The user already has 5 pending suggestions.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's suggestions with their statuses, newest first.

200.description: Suggestions retrieved successfully. An empty result returns an empty data array.

get.description: Returns a suggestion with its author. Requires the admin role.

400.description: The suggestion ID is invalid.

post.description: Creates the place given in the body from a pending suggestion and marks the suggestion approved as that place. Requires the admin role. If the suggestion cannot be marked approved, the created place is deleted again.

200.description: Suggestion approved successfully. place_id is the ID of the created place.

400.description: The suggestion ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or a place value failed validation. A missing location, an unknown sub-district or category, and a place name or attributes that are not valid are all reported here.

value.message: location is required and must be within Indonesia

409.description: The suggestion has already been approved or rejected.

post.description: Marks a pending suggestion rejected, storing the optional reason with it. Requires the admin role. The body is a JSON object; reason may be left out or null.

400.description: The suggestion ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or the reason is longer than 1000 characters.

value.message: reason must be 1000 characters or fewer

409.description: The suggestion has already been approved or rejected.

post.description: Creates a sub-district. Requires the admin role.

409.description: A sub-district with this name or slug already exists.

example.message: sub-district with this name or slug already exists

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid.

put.description: Replaces a sub-district's editable fields. Requires the admin role. Send every field: nullable fields left out or sent as null are cleared. The sub-district's medias and boundary are kept.

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or a value failed validation.

409.description: A sub-district with this name or slug already exists.

example.message: sub-district with this name or slug already exists

delete.description: Deletes a sub-district. Requires the admin role. Fails with 409 while places reference it.

204.description: Sub-district deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid.

409.description: The sub-district is referenced by places.

post.description: Returns a presigned URL for uploading a new image of the sub-district straight to storage. Requires the admin role. Send the image as the body of a request with the returned method and headers before expires_at (5 minutes), then confirm it with POST /v1/subdistricts/{id}/medias. Unconfirmed uploads are deleted after a day.

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid, the body is malformed, or the content type is not JPEG, PNG, or WebP.

value.message: image must be JPEG, PNG, or WebP

post.description: Confirms an uploaded image and adds it to the sub-district's medias at the lowest free position (1 to 10). Requires the admin role. A sub-district has at most 10 medias. The upload must have been requested for this sub-district's medias, and the image must be a JPEG, PNG, or WebP of at most 5 MB whose type matches the one it was requested for.

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid, the body is malformed, the upload key is not one requested for this sub-district's medias, nothing was uploaded under it, or the image is too large or of the wrong type.

delete.description: Removes the media from the sub-district and deletes its image. The other medias keep their positions. Requires the admin role.

204.description: Media deleted successfully. No response body.

400.description: The sub-district ID or the media ID is invalid.

404.description: The sub-district has no such media.

put.description: Makes the GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in the body the sub-district's boundary, replacing the previous one. Requires the admin role. A Polygon is stored and returned as a MultiPolygon. Every ring must be closed and have at least four positions, every vertex must lie within Indonesia (longitude 95 to 141, latitude -11 to 6), and the area must not cross itself.

400.description: The sub-district ID is invalid, the body is not a well-formed GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, or the area lies outside Indonesia or crosses itself.

value.message: boundary must lie in Indonesia and must not cross itself

access_token.description: Bearer token for endpoints that require authentication.

Point.description: GeoJSON Point in WGS 84 (SRID 4326). Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] and must lie within Indonesia: longitude 95 to 141, latitude -11 to 6.

Polygon.description: GeoJSON Polygon in WGS 84 (SRID 4326): an outer ring, then any holes. Each ring is a closed list of at least four [longitude, latitude] positions.

MultiPolygon.description: GeoJSON MultiPolygon in WGS 84 (SRID 4326): a list of polygons, each laid out as a Polygon's coordinates.

PlaceRequest.description: A place's editable fields. Used to create a place and to replace one: an update sends every field, and keys left out are cleared.

attributes.description: Values for the chosen category's custom fields, keyed by field key. Required fields must be present.

code.description: The single character that marks the category on a map sign.

attributes.description: Values for the category's custom fields, keyed by field key.

rating_average.description: Mean star rating of the place's reviews, from 1 to 5; null before the first review.

rating_count.description: Number of reviews of the place.

medias.description: The place's images in position order; empty if it has none.

content_type.description: Content type of the image that will be uploaded.

upload_key.description: Key the image is uploaded under. Send it to confirm the upload.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL to send the image to, as the raw request body.

headers.description: Headers to send with the upload exactly as given, including Content-Type.

expires_at.description: Time after which the upload URL is rejected.

upload_key.description: upload_key returned when the upload was requested.

size.description: Size of the image in bytes.

position.description: Position of the image among its owner's medias.

comment.description: Optional. Trimmed; a blank comment is stored as null.

medias.description: The review's medias in position order, or [] if it has none.

code.description: The single character that marks the category on a map sign.

CategoryColor.description: Palette key that clients map to their own styles.

SubDistrictRequest.description: A sub-district's editable fields. Used to create a sub-district and to replace one: an update sends every field, and keys left out are cleared.

medias.description: The sub-district's images in position order; empty if it has none.

boundary.description: The sub-district's area; null if it has none. Set it with PUT /v1/subdistricts/{id}/boundary.

SuggestionStatus.description: A suggestion is pending until an admin approves or rejects it. It is reviewed once and does not change after that.

address.description: Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

operating_hours.description: Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

estimated_price_range.description: Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

short_description.description: Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

attributes.description: Values for the chosen category's custom fields, keyed by field key. Stored as sent and checked against the category when the suggestion is approved. A missing or null value is stored as an empty object.

note.description: Message to the reviewer. Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

ApproveSuggestionRequest.description: The place to create from the suggestion, in the shape of a place. The location is required.

attributes.description: Values for the chosen category's custom fields, keyed by field key. Required fields must be present.

reason.description: Why the suggestion was rejected. Trimmed; blank is stored as null.

attributes.description: Values for the chosen category's custom fields, keyed by field key.

rejection_reason.description: Reason the suggestion was rejected; null unless it was rejected with a reason.

place_id.description: ID of the place the suggestion was approved as; null unless it was approved.

reviewed_at.description: When the suggestion was approved or rejected; null while it is pending.

BadRequest.description: The request body is malformed or a path or query parameter is invalid.

ValidationError.description: The request body is malformed or failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user does not have the admin role.

InternalServerError.description: An internal error occurred while processing the request.

BearerAuth.description: Access token returned by login or refresh.

RefreshTokenCookie.name: refresh_token
RefreshTokenCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh token cookie scoped to /v1/auth.
